record.question: You are travelling in your official car and during the journey someone is hit by your car and dies on the spot, what you will do?
options: Ask the driver to drive fast.
Ask the driver to stop car and move out to take the person to the hospital.
Ask the driver to reach the nearby police station and surrender there.
Put all the blame on your driver to save yourself.
